name: Anaesthesia Machine
description: A device used to deliver controlled anaesthetic gases and support ventilation during surgery.
principle: Controls and delivers a mixture of oxygen, anaesthetic agents and other gases while supporting breathing.

name: Mechanical Ventilator
description: Provides respiratory support to patients who cannot breathe adequately on their own.
principle: Uses controlled pressure, volume or flow to move gas into and out of the lungs.

name: Patient Monitor
description: Continuously monitors physiological parameters such as heart rate, blood pressure and oxygen saturation.
principle: Uses sensors and electronic signal processing to measure and display physiological parameters.

name: Electrocardiograph (ECG)
description: Records the electrical activity of the heart.
principle: Detects cardiac electrical signals through electrodes placed on the patient's body.

name: Pulse Oximeter
description: Estimates blood oxygen saturation and pulse rate non-invasively.
principle: Uses differences in red and infrared light absorption by oxygenated and deoxygenated haemoglobin.

name: Centrifuge
description: Separates sample components according to their density.
principle: Uses centrifugal force generated by rapid rotation to separate components of a sample.

name: Microscope
description: Magnifies small specimens and microorganisms for examination.
principle: Uses optical lenses to magnify and resolve structures that cannot be clearly seen with the naked eye.

name: Ultrasound Machine
description: Produces images of internal body structures using high-frequency sound waves.
principle: Transmits ultrasound waves into the body and processes returning echoes to create images.

name: X-Ray Machine
description: Produces images of internal body structures using X-rays.
principle: X-rays pass through the body and are absorbed differently by different tissues before reaching a detector.

name: Defibrillator
description: Delivers an electrical shock for certain life-threatening cardiac arrhythmias.
principle: Delivers a controlled electrical energy discharge through electrodes to influence cardiac electrical activity.

name: Infusion Pump
description: Delivers fluids or medications to a patient at a controlled rate.
principle: Uses a motor-driven pumping mechanism and electronic controls to regulate fluid delivery.

name: Syringe Pump
description: Delivers small, controlled volumes of medication from a syringe.
principle: A motor-driven mechanism advances the syringe plunger at a programmed rate.

name: Suction Machine
description: Removes fluids, secretions and debris from a patient's airway or a surgical site.
principle: Creates negative pressure to draw fluids through tubing into a collection container.

name: Electrosurgical Unit
description: Uses high-frequency electrical energy to cut tissue or control bleeding during surgery.
principle: Converts electrical energy into localized heat within tissue to achieve cutting or coagulation.

name: Operating Theatre Light
description: Provides focused illumination of the surgical field.
principle: Uses an array of light sources and optical components to illuminate the operative area while limiting shadows.

name: Autoclave
description: Sterilizes suitable medical instruments and materials using pressurized steam.
principle: Uses saturated steam at controlled temperature and pressure for a validated exposure time to destroy microorganisms.

name: Haematology Analyzer
description: Measures blood cell parameters and generates complete blood count results.
principle: Depending on the model, uses electrical impedance, optical analysis, flow cytometry or combinations of these methods.

name: Clinical Chemistry Analyzer
description: Measures chemical substances in blood and other body fluids.
principle: Uses analytical methods such as photometry, colorimetry or ion-selective electrodes to measure selected analytes.

name: Blood Gas Analyzer
description: Measures blood gas and acid-base parameters.
principle: Uses specialized electrochemical sensors to measure parameters such as pH, oxygen and carbon dioxide partial pressures.

name: Incubator
description: Maintains controlled environmental conditions for laboratory samples or cell cultures.
principle: Uses temperature control and, depending on the model, humidity and gas regulation to maintain specified conditions.

name: Laboratory Refrigerator
description: Stores laboratory reagents, samples and other materials within specified temperature limits.
principle: Uses a refrigeration system and temperature controller to maintain the required storage temperature.

name: Blood Bank Refrigerator
description: Maintains suitable controlled storage conditions for blood components intended for transfusion.
principle: Uses a monitored refrigeration system designed to maintain the specified temperature range for the stored component.

name: Dialysis Machine
description: Supports haemodialysis by removing waste products and excess fluid from a patient's blood.
principle: Blood and dialysate flow on opposite sides of a semipermeable membrane, allowing diffusion and controlled fluid removal.

name: CT Scanner
description: Produces cross-sectional images of the body using X-rays and computer processing.
principle: Collects X-ray measurements from multiple angles and reconstructs them into cross-sectional images.

name: MRI Scanner
description: Produces detailed images of internal structures using magnetic fields and radiofrequency signals.
principle: Uses a strong magnetic field, radiofrequency excitation and signal processing to generate images from tissue responses.

name: Mammography Machine
description: Produces specialized X-ray images of breast tissue.
principle: Uses low-energy X-rays and breast compression to obtain detailed images of breast tissue.

name: Slit Lamp
description: Allows detailed examination of the front structures of the eye.
principle: Combines magnification with a narrow beam of light to examine ocular structures.

name: Phacoemulsification Machine
description: Supports cataract surgery by fragmenting and removing the eye's cloudy natural lens.
principle: Uses an ultrasonic handpiece with controlled fluid irrigation and aspiration to remove lens material.

name: Phototherapy Unit
description: Provides therapeutic light for treating neonatal jaundice.
principle: Uses light at appropriate wavelengths to transform bilirubin into forms that can be eliminated more easily.

name: Dental Unit
description: Provides an integrated workstation for dental examinations and procedures.
principle: Combines a patient chair, illumination, instrument delivery systems and, depending on the model, water and suction systems.
